BiblicalUsage: Mud is to shake, to measure out — He stood, and measured the earth, He beheld, and drove asunder the nations, and the everlasting mountains were scattered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the shaking is the measure: God stands still, and the nations fall apart at a look.
RelatedTopics: God's Sovereignty; Judgment; Majesty of God
